photos.c: On page to Right Top The Start P.Eales(39) and R.Treadwell(43) to the fore for Surrey closely followed by R.Nerurker(21) and S.Fielding(20) for (E.C.C.U) and Belgravians J.Wright(18),J.Gladwin(10), J.Chaston(5),G.Tiernan(16),F.Ward(17) and M.Chaston(6).
In the finishing straight,Justin Chaston(5) just fails to catch M.Hawkins(E.C.C.U)but beats K.Lamb(Derby),S.Fielding(E.C.C.U)and M.Flint(E.C.C.U).A great run by our leading Junior.
